sources.quote: A deck must be constructed entirely using either one or two card colors.
Up to two unique card colors (red, blue, green, white, purple) can be included in a deck. Cards of a tertiary or more colors cannot be added to a deck.

effective_date_notes: Comprehensive Rules Ver. 1.9.0 (Sep 11, 2026), section 6-1. Other pages agree: play guide (undated), How to Start Deck Building (2025-07-25), TRM (2025-07-10), BO3 Match Rules (2026-07-03).

main_deck.copy_identity: card_number; all printings (product_id suffix _p1, _p2, ...) of one card number are the same card; same name with different card numbers counts separately (FAQ Q4)

sources.quote: Before the game, each player prepares a deck and a resource deck. A deck consists of exactly 50 cards, and a resource deck consists of exactly 10 cards.
A deck is constructed with Unit, Pilot, Command, and Base cards.
Up to four copies of cards with the same card number can be included in a deck.
Yes, you can. As long as their card numbers are different, you can include four copies of each different card in your deck, even if their card names are the same.
Cards with the same card number and different illustrations are still considered the same card.
A resource deck is constructed with Resource cards.
Any number of Resource cards with the same card number can be included in a resource deck.
A resource deck must be constructed using only cards of the Resource card type. Any number of copies of Resource cards with the same card number may be included.
For your sideboard, you may prepare exactly 10 cards that are separate from your main deck.

sources.ref: TRM 2.4 (2025-07-10, superseded for BO3 by the 2026-07-03 BO3 page)

tokens.other_tokens: prepared as needed outside the game; not part of either deck

sources.quote: Before the game, each player prepares one EX Base and one EX Resource token card.
If you intend to use other tokens, make sure to have the necessary token cards at hand.
Place them together someplace outside of the playing area.

tournament_only_rules_not_modelled: 7-day new-card rule for Premier events (TRM 2.4.1; Sanctioned Floor Rules Section 5)
